interface.longDescription:
Haystack connects ChatGPT to your company's Haystack workspace so you can search for people, teams, posts, events, knowledge pages, glossary terms, files, and links you're already allowed to see, and open results directly in Haystack.

With your permission, ChatGPT can also create content for you:
• Create private knowledge pages that only you can see
• Draft posts and events in your groups without notifying anyone
• Publish posts and events when you explicitly ask, which may notify group members through email, mobile, Slack, or Microsoft Teams

ChatGPT shows you the post or event before creating it, and only publishes when you ask. Posting and event creation only work in groups where you already have permission.

The integration is optional, uses secure OAuth, and respects your existing access controls. It does not expand permissions or use your content to train models.

Availability depends on your organization's Haystack setup. To enable the ChatGPT connector for your organization or check your eligibility, please reach out to your Haystack Customer Success Manager or contact support@haystackteam.com.
